string_literals: All Event Tile builders must be assigned
CalendarEvent end must be after start
CalendarEvent start must be before end
End hour must be between 1 and 24
End hour must be greater than start hour
EventTileBuilder and MultiDayEventTileBuilder must be assigned
Number of days must be greater than 0
Start hour must be before end hour
Start hour must be between 0 and 22
The current view does not support adjusting the height per minute.
The current view does not support animating to the next page.
The current view does not support animating to the previous page.
The current view does not support jumping to a page.
The date must be within the dateTimeRange of the event
